findings: Both captures describe the US mobile reader using BLE, or USB for Android only, with iOS, Android and React Native Terminal SDKs. On a powered reader, pressing/releasing once checks battery; textual states distinguish waiting/searching, connected flashes, standby, bootloader, tamper and integrity failure.

The November top row labeled Latest Version is a full bundled software string different from the highest/latest dated standalone firmware row. It is documentary evidence, with no attribution for what is deployed to any reader.

The available-in badge, USB restriction, SDK compatibility, LED meanings, configurational history and accessory conditions persist. Table formatting and the new Changelog heading are presentational.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/readers/stripe-m2, source-stripe-terminal-stripe-m2 describes the US Stripe Reader M2 with BLE or Android-only USB connecting to a Terminal mobile SDK. iOS, Android and React Native are compatible (old raw lines 4-11 and new raw lines 5-12). With the reader on, the operator can press and release once to view battery level. Waiting for BLE/USB scans back and forth, and a connection flashes three times. The reference also describes bootloader, standby, tamper and failed integrity check states (old raw lines 27-50 and new raw lines 28-51). The historical 2.01.01.00 firmware defines power-off as holding 4 seconds then releasing and reset as holding 14 seconds then releasing. The 2.01.00.31 entry records UID collection for NFC instruments via Terminal.collectData (old raw lines 69-84 and new raw lines 78-90). Both captures preserve optional dock/mount and require reviewing and accepting the design-file license for mechanical files (old raw lines 115-121 and new raw lines 121-127). The current summary captures most stable capabilities but echoes the May latest string and single-key conclusion. November's top software field is 2.01.04.00-SZZZ_Prod_US_v12-481001, while the firmware section separately reaches 2.01.07.01 and the key table still lists 480001 (old raw lines 57-74 and old raw lines 109-113, new raw lines 58-80 and new raw lines 115-119).
